event.title: Laos Unable to Confirm Methanol Poisoning in Tourist Deaths Due to Lack of Autopsies
event.canonical_title: Laos Unable to Confirm Methanol Poisoning in Tourist Deaths Due to Lack of Autopsies
event.summary: Laos officials have stated that they cannot determine the cause of deaths of tourists linked to methanol poisoning due to the absence of autopsies. As a result, there is no evidence to support claims of poisoning. Those indicted in connection with the deaths are facing charges related to selling harmful food and operating an illegal business.
